description.value:
Requirement You occupy a space at least two sides of which are walls, wreckage, or otherwise impassable.

Duration until you move

Corridors, stairwells, the inside of a bus. Places with only one way through are yours.

Brace the choke point. While you remain there, enemies attempting to move past or through your space must succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC or have their movement stop, and your ranged Strikes against creatures adjacent to you deal an additional die of damage.

cinderfall.incomplete: (the Reflex-save movement-stop targets other creatures with no companion Effect item). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
